# CPLT Online — a private AI demonstration

cplt.online contains illustrative, fictional document examples and a simulated
interface. It explains model routing, document extraction, source checks and
human review. It is not a customer case study or a published production benchmark.

CPLT is the association founded by Stéphane Lepain. His experience operating
private AI systems predates CPLT. Commercial services, scoping and contact
information live at https://cplt.tech.

Pages:
- [Overview](https://cplt.online/): explore the demonstration
- [See it fail](https://cplt.online/demo): simulated extraction failure and review
- [How it works](https://cplt.online/how-it-works): an illustrative review workflow and chat interface
- [Architecture](https://cplt.online/deployment): deployment and data-boundary choices
- [Security](https://cplt.online/security): permissions, recovery targets and restore testing

Actual build scope, performance and acceptance criteria are agreed for each
customer environment. Contact: https://cplt.tech/contact.
